revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the commercial owner framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. The commercial owner described the rule as a gate, not a smooth surcharge. Crossing a named business line changes eligibility for the allowance, desk, setup, waiver, or fee; staying on the other side does not. The delivery plan is now managed destination by destination across three sales points and three days. Each sales point has its committed share of demand and its own service discipline: on a given sales point-day, deliveries must come from either the truck/electric-vehicle family or the van/motorcycle family. Sales-point truck share promises and the overall `max_total_pollution` ceiling remain part of the operating commitment. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
